subject.title: fix(tool-call-repair): parse JSON-format plain-text tool calls alongside bracket/XML/Harmony

question: Should providers using the shared plain-text compatibility wrapper automatically execute standalone JSON assistant content, or must JSON promotion be an explicit provider-owned opt-in while native Ollama transport remains canonical?
rationale: The patch broadens executable model-output interpretation across multiple provider wrappers, while the linked Ollama setup has a documented native transport alternative; automation cannot choose this permanent compatibility and trust boundary.

options.title: Require provider-explicit JSON compatibility
options.body: Keep the parser work but require each affected provider wrapper to opt into JSON promotion and prove its real response shape on the exact head.

options.title: Accept the shared wrapper default
options.body: Allow every provider already using this compatibility wrapper to promote valid registered-tool JSON after exact-path live proof is added.

options.title: Keep native or structured calls only
options.body: Do not merge the JSON fallback and keep the linked Ollama work focused on native transport configuration or response normalization.

recommendation.title: Require provider-explicit JSON compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep the parser work but require each affected provider wrapper to opt into JSON promotion and prove its real response shape on the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined history across provider runtime, plugin SDK policy, and the shared plain-text repair boundary.
